title: अमेरिकी संसदीय प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले भेट्यो सभामुखलाई
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । सभामुख डीपी अर्यालसँग संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाको तल्लो सदनको वेज एण्ड मिन्स कमिटीका सभापति जेसन स्मिथसहितको संसदीय प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले शिष्टाचार भेट गरेको छ । भेटका क्रममा नेपाल–अमेरिका द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्ध, आपसी सहयोग, आर्थिक साझेदारी, जलवायु परिवर्तनबाट उत्पन्न विपद् व्यवस्थापन तथा संसदीय सहकार्यलगायतका साझा चासोका विषयमा विचार आदानप्रदान भएको सभामुखको सचिवालयले जनाएको छ । भेटका क्रममा सभामुख अर्यालले रसुवा तथा भोटेकोशी क्षेत्रमा आएको बाढीबाट उत्पन्न विपद् व्यवस्थापनमा नेपाल सरकारले हरसम्भव प्रयास गरेको उल्लेख गर्दै विपद्को कठिन घडीमा संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाले नेपालप्रति देखाएको ऐक्यबद्धता र सहयोगका लागि अमेरिकी सरकारप्रति धन्यवाद व्यक्त गरे । यस्तै सभामुख अर्यालले तान्जानियाको आरुषामा हालै सम्पन्न अन्तरव्यवस्थापिका संघ (आईपीयू) को १५३औँ महासभामा नेपालका तर्फबाट प्रस्तुत जलवायुसम्बन्धी विपद्को सामना गर्न तथा हिमालय क्षेत्र र अन्य जोखिममा रहेका क्षेत्रको उत्थानशीलता सुदृढ गर्न तत्काल संसदीय पहल विषयक आपत्कालीन एजेन्डा दुई तिहाइभन्दा बढी मतसहित पारित भएको जानकारी गराए । जलवायु परिवर्तनका कारण विपद्को उच्च जोखिममा रहेका क्षेत्रको क्षति न्यूनीकरण, विपद् पूर्वतयारी तथा उत्थानशीलता सुदृढ गर्न अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय र अन्तरसंसदीय सहकार्यलाई थप प्रभावकारी बनाउनुपर्नेमा जोड दिए । साथै, जलवायुजन्य विपद्को सामना गर्न अनुदानमा मात्र निर्भर नभई आर्थिक तथा प्राविधिक क्षमता भएका राष्ट्रहरूले जिम्मेवारीपूर्वक सहकार्य र सहयोग गर्नुपर्ने धारणा राखे । नेपाल–अमेरिका सम्बन्धलाई परम्परागत अनुदान सहयोगमा मात्र सीमित नराखी लगानी तथा आर्थिक साझेदारी अभिवृद्धितर्फ अघि बढाउनुपर्ने उल्लेख गर्दै सभामुख अर्यालले नेपालमा लगानीमैत्री वातावरण निर्माण गर्न तथा लगानीकर्ताको मनोबल उच्च राख्न आवश्यक नीतिगत र कानुनी सुधारका लागि प्रतिबद्ध रहेको बताए । अमेरिकी संसद्मा रहेका संसदीय ककस तथा नेपाल–अमेरिका संसदीय मैत्री समूहबीच निरन्तर सहकार्य र संवादलाई अघि बढाउने विश्वास व्यक्त गरे। संसदीय भ्रमण तथा आदानप्रदानले दुई देशबीचको मैत्रीपूर्ण सम्बन्ध र संसदीय कूटनीति प्रवर्धनमा महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेल्ने उल्लेख गर्दै अमेरिकी प्रतिनिधिमण्डललाई नेपाल भ्रमण गरेकोमा धन्यवाद दिए। उक्त अवसरमा अमेरिकी संसदीय प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले रसुवा तथा भोटेकोशी क्षेत्रमा आएको बाढीबाट नेपालले भोग्नुपरेको क्षतिप्रति सहानुभूति व्यक्त गर्दै ज्यान गुमाउनेहरूप्रति श्रद्धाञ्जली अर्पण र शोकसन्तप्त परिवारप्रति गहिरो दुःख व्यक्त गरेको थियो। प्राकृतिक सौन्दर्य र सांस्कृतिक सम्पदाले समृद्ध नेपाल भ्रमणले नयाँ ऊर्जा थपेको उल्लेख गर्दै प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले नेपाल र अमेरिकाबीचको द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्ध सुमधुर तथा विश्वासमा आधारित रहेको बताएको थियो। साथै, नेपालको आर्थिक, सामाजिक, भौतिक तथा मानवीय विकासमा निरन्तर सहयोग गर्न र दुई देशबीचको संसदीय कूटनीतिक सम्बन्धलाई थप सुदृढ बनाउन इच्छुक रहेको धारणा व्यक्त गरेको थियो। भेटमा प्रतिनिधिसभाको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्ध तथा पर्यटन समिति र संसदीय सुनुवाइ समितिका सभापतिसमेत सहभागी थिए। Kathmandu. A parliamentary delegation including Jason Smith, Chairman of the Ways and Means Committee of the United States House of Representatives, paid a courtesy call on Speaker DP Aryal. During the meeting, views were exchanged on issues of common interest, including Nepal-US bilateral relations, mutual cooperation, economic partnership, disaster management arising from climate change, and parliamentary cooperation, according to the Speaker's Secretariat. During the meeting, Speaker Aryal mentioned that the Government of Nepal has made every possible effort in disaster management arising from the floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi regions and expressed gratitude to the US government for the solidarity and support shown by the United States towards Nepal during the difficult time of the disaster. Similarly, Speaker Aryal informed that the emergency agenda on urgent parliamentary initiatives to combat climate-related disasters and strengthen the resilience of the Himalayan region and other vulnerable areas, presented by Nepal, was passed with more than two-thirds of the votes at the 153rd General Assembly of the Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) recently held in Arusha, Tanzania. He emphasized the need to make international and inter-parliamentary cooperation more effective to reduce damage, strengthen disaster preparedness, and resilience in areas at high risk of disasters due to climate change. He also expressed the view that countries with economic and technical capacity should responsibly collaborate and support each other to combat climate-related disasters, rather than relying solely on grants. Stating that Nepal-US relations should not be limited to traditional grant aid but should be moved towards increasing investment and economic partnership, Speaker Aryal said that he is committed to the necessary policy and legal reforms to create an investment-friendly environment in Nepal and keep investor morale high. He expressed confidence in advancing continued cooperation and dialogue between the Parliamentary Caucus in the US House of Representatives and the Nepal-US Parliamentary Friendship Group. Stating that parliamentary visits and exchanges play an important role in promoting friendly relations and parliamentary diplomacy between the two countries, he thanked the US delegation for visiting Nepal. On that occasion, the US parliamentary delegation expressed sympathy for the damage Nepal has suffered due to the floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi regions, paid tribute to those who lost their lives, and expressed deep sorrow for the bereaved families. Noting that the visit to Nepal, rich in natural beauty and cultural heritage, has added new energy, the delegation stated that the bilateral relations between Nepal and the US are harmonious and based on trust. It also expressed its willingness to continue supporting Nepal's economic, social, physical and human development and to further strengthen the parliamentary diplomatic relations between the two countries. The meeting was also attended by the Chairmen of the International Relations and Tourism Committee and the Parliamentary Hearing Committee of the House of Representatives.

भएको जानकारी गराए । जलवायु परिवर्तनका कारण विपद्को उच्च जोखिममा रहेका क्षेत्रको क्षति न्यूनीकरण, विपद् पूर्वतयारी तथा उत्थानशीलता सुदृढ गर्न अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय र अन्तरसंसदीय सहकार्यलाई थप प्रभावकारी बनाउनुपर्नेमा जोड दिए । साथै, जलवायुजन्य विपद्को सामना गर्न अनुदानमा मात्र निर्भर नभई आर्थिक तथा प्राविधिक क्षमता भएका राष्ट्रहरूले जिम्मेवारीपूर्वक सहकार्य र सहयोग गर्नुपर्ने धारणा राखे । नेपाल–अमेरिका सम्बन्धलाई परम्परागत अनुदान सहयोगमा मात्र सीमित नराखी लगानी तथा आर्थिक साझेदारी अभिवृद्धितर्फ अघि बढाउनुपर्ने उल्लेख गर्दै सभामुख अर्यालले नेपालमा लगानीमैत्री वातावरण निर्माण गर्न तथा लगानीकर्ताको मनोबल उच्च राख्न आवश्यक नीतिगत र कानुनी सुधारका लागि प्रतिबद्ध रहेको बताए । अमेरिकी संसद्मा रहेका संसदीय ककस तथा नेपाल–अमेरिका संसदीय मैत्री समूहबीच निरन्तर सहकार्य र संवादलाई अघि बढाउने विश्वास व्यक्त गरे। संसदीय भ्रमण तथा आदानप्रदानले दुई देशबीचको मैत्रीपूर्ण सम्बन्ध र संसदीय कूटनीति प्रवर्धनमा महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेल्ने उल्लेख गर्दै अमेरिकी प्रतिनिधिमण्डललाई नेपाल भ्रमण गरेकोमा धन्यवाद दिए। उक्त अवसरमा अमेरिकी संसदीय प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले रसुवा तथा भोटेकोशी क्षेत्रमा आएको बाढीबाट नेपालले भोग्नुपरेको क्षतिप्रति सहानुभूति व्यक्त गर्दै ज्यान गुमाउनेहरूप्रति श्रद्धाञ्जली अर्पण र शोकसन्तप्त परिवारप्रति गहिरो दुःख व्यक्त गरेको थियो। प्राकृतिक सौन्दर्य र सांस्कृतिक सम्पदाले समृद्ध नेपाल भ्रमणले नयाँ ऊर्जा थपेको उल्लेख गर्दै प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले नेपाल र अमेरिकाबीचको द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्ध सुमधुर तथा विश्वासमा आधारित रहेको बताएको थियो। साथै, नेपालको आर्थिक, सामाजिक, भौतिक तथा मानवीय विकासमा निरन्तर सहयोग गर्न र दुई देशबीचको संसदीय कूटनीतिक सम्बन्धलाई थप सुदृढ बनाउन इच्छुक रहेको धारणा व्यक्त गरेको थियो। भेटमा प्रतिनिधिसभाको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्ध तथा पर्यटन समिति र संसदीय सुनुवाइ समितिका सभापतिसमेत सहभागी थिए। Kathmandu. A parliamentary delegation including Jason Smith, Chairman of the Ways and Means Committee of the United States House of Representatives, paid a courtesy call on Speaker DP Aryal. During the meeting, views were exchanged on issues of common interest, including Nepal-US bilateral relations, mutual cooperation, economic partnership, disaster management arising from climate change, and parliamentary cooperation, according to the Speaker's Secretariat. During the meeting, Speaker Aryal mentioned that the Government of Nepal has made every possible effort in disaster management arising from the floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi regions and expressed gratitude to the US government for the solidarity and support shown by the United States towards Nepal during the difficult time of the disaster. Similarly, Speaker Aryal informed that the emergency agenda on urgent parliamentary initiatives to combat climate-related disasters and strengthen the resilience of the Himalayan region and other vulnerable areas, presented by Nepal, was passed with more than two-thirds of the votes at the 153rd General Assembly of the Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) recently held in Arusha, Tanzania. He emphasized the need to make international and inter-parliamentary cooperation more effective to reduce damage, strengthen disaster preparedness, and resilience in areas at high risk of disasters due to climate change. He also expressed the view that countries with economic and technical capacity should responsibly collaborate and support each other to combat climate-related disasters, rather than relying solely on grants. Stating that Nepal-US relations should not be limited to traditional grant aid but should be moved towards increasing investment and economic partnership, Speaker Aryal said that he is committed to the necessary policy and legal reforms to create an investment-friendly environment in Nepal and keep investor morale high. He expressed confidence in advancing continued cooperation and dialogue between the Parliamentary Caucus in the US House of Representatives and the Nepal-US Parliamentary Friendship Group. Stating that parliamentary visits and exchanges play an important role in promoting friendly relations and parliamentary diplomacy between the two countries, he thanked the US delegation for visiting Nepal. On that occasion, the US parliamentary delegation expressed sympathy for the damage Nepal has suffered due to the floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi regions, paid tribute to those who lost their lives, and expressed deep sorrow for the bereaved families. Noting that the visit to Nepal, rich in natural beauty and cultural heritage, has added new energy, the delegation stated that the bilateral relations between Nepal and the US are harmonious and based on trust. It also expressed its willingness to continue supporting Nepal's economic, social, physical and human development and to further strengthen the parliamentary diplomatic relations between the two countries. The meeting was also attended by the Chairmen of the International Relations and Tourism Committee and the Parliamentary Hearing Committee of the House of Representatives.

विश्वास व्यक्त गरे। संसदीय भ्रमण तथा आदानप्रदानले दुई देशबीचको मैत्रीपूर्ण सम्बन्ध र संसदीय कूटनीति प्रवर्धनमा महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेल्ने उल्लेख गर्दै अमेरिकी प्रतिनिधिमण्डललाई नेपाल भ्रमण गरेकोमा धन्यवाद दिए। उक्त अवसरमा अमेरिकी संसदीय प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले रसुवा तथा भोटेकोशी क्षेत्रमा आएको बाढीबाट नेपालले भोग्नुपरेको क्षतिप्रति सहानुभूति व्यक्त गर्दै ज्यान गुमाउनेहरूप्रति श्रद्धाञ्जली अर्पण र शोकसन्तप्त परिवारप्रति गहिरो दुःख व्यक्त गरेको थियो। प्राकृतिक सौन्दर्य र सांस्कृतिक सम्पदाले समृद्ध नेपाल भ्रमणले नयाँ ऊर्जा थपेको उल्लेख गर्दै प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले नेपाल र अमेरिकाबीचको द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्ध सुमधुर तथा विश्वासमा आधारित रहेको बताएको थियो। साथै, नेपालको आर्थिक, सामाजिक, भौतिक तथा मानवीय विकासमा निरन्तर सहयोग गर्न र दुई देशबीचको संसदीय कूटनीतिक सम्बन्धलाई थप सुदृढ बनाउन इच्छुक रहेको धारणा व्यक्त गरेको थियो। भेटमा प्रतिनिधिसभाको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बन्ध तथा पर्यटन समिति र संसदीय सुनुवाइ समितिका सभापतिसमेत सहभागी थिए। Kathmandu. A parliamentary delegation including Jason Smith, Chairman of the Ways and Means Committee of the United States House of Representatives, paid a courtesy call on Speaker DP Aryal. During the meeting, views were exchanged on issues of common interest, including Nepal-US bilateral relations, mutual cooperation, economic partnership, disaster management arising from climate change, and parliamentary cooperation, according to the Speaker's Secretariat. During the meeting, Speaker Aryal mentioned that the Government of Nepal has made every possible effort in disaster management arising from the floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi regions and expressed gratitude to the US government for the solidarity and support shown by the United States towards Nepal during the difficult time of the disaster. Similarly, Speaker Aryal informed that the emergency agenda on urgent parliamentary initiatives to combat climate-related disasters and strengthen the resilience of the Himalayan region and other vulnerable areas, presented by Nepal, was passed with more than two-thirds of the votes at the 153rd General Assembly of the Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) recently held in Arusha, Tanzania. He emphasized the need to make international and inter-parliamentary cooperation more effective to reduce damage, strengthen disaster preparedness, and resilience in areas at high risk of disasters due to climate change. He also expressed the view that countries with economic and technical capacity should responsibly collaborate and support each other to combat climate-related disasters, rather than relying solely on grants. Stating that Nepal-US relations should not be limited to traditional grant aid but should be moved towards increasing investment and economic partnership, Speaker Aryal said that he is committed to the necessary policy and legal reforms to create an investment-friendly environment in Nepal and keep investor morale high. He expressed confidence in advancing continued cooperation and dialogue between the Parliamentary Caucus in the US House of Representatives and the Nepal-US Parliamentary Friendship Group. Stating that parliamentary visits and exchanges play an important role in promoting friendly relations and parliamentary diplomacy between the two countries, he thanked the US delegation for visiting Nepal. On that occasion, the US parliamentary delegation expressed sympathy for the damage Nepal has suffered due to the floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi regions, paid tribute to those who lost their lives, and expressed deep sorrow for the bereaved families. Noting that the visit to Nepal, rich in natural beauty and cultural heritage, has added new energy, the delegation stated that the bilateral relations between Nepal and the US are harmonious and based on trust. It also expressed its willingness to continue supporting Nepal's economic, social, physical and human development and to further strengthen the parliamentary diplomatic relations between the two countries. The meeting was also attended by the Chairmen of the International Relations and Tourism Committee and the Parliamentary Hearing Committee of the House of Representatives.

काठमाडौँ । सभामुख डीपी अर्यालसँग संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाको तल्लो सदनको वेज एण्ड मिन्स कमिटीका सभापति जेसन स्मिथसहितको संसदीय प्रतिनिधिमण्डलले शिष्टाचार भेट गरेको छ । भेटका क्रममा नेपाल–अमेरिका द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्ध, आपसी सहयोग, आर्थिक साझेदारी, जलवायु परिवर्तनबाट उत्पन्न विपद् व्यवस्थापन तथा संसदीय सहकार्यलगायतका साझा चासोका विषयमा विचार आदानप्रदान भएको सभामुखको सचिवालयले जनाएको छ । भेटका क्रममा सभामुख अर्यालले रसुवा तथा भोटेकोशी क्षेत्रमा आएको बाढीबाट उत्पन्न विपद् व्यवस्थापनमा नेपाल सरकारले हरसम्भव प्रयास गरेको उल्लेख गर्दै विपद्को कठिन घडीमा संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाले नेपालप्रति
